mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the 'exactly one producing operation per audit entry' constraint; injecting an orphan AuditEntry creates a row that cannot be traced to any Operation, which is exactly the shadow-update / shadow-insert pattern AppendOnly forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | all op: Operation | ae not in op.producedAudit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the auth boundary fact lets an unauthenticated request succeed; injecting an Operation with authenticated=BFalse and outcome=Success directly contradicts FR-001's 'reject before any business logic'.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnauthSucceeds { some op: Operation | op.authenticated = BFalse and op.outcome = Success }

mutation_targets.rationale: Without this fact, a cross-team caller can receive ValidationFail (or similar) instead of the byte-equivalent 404, leaking the existence of restricted resources. The injection forces an Outsider/InTeamNone caller's outcome to be ValidationFail, which violates the byte-equivalence contract while still respecting the permission matrix (no Success).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakyOutsider { some op: Operation | op.authenticated = BTrue and some op.target and op.opKind = ViewTaskKind and op.relationship = OutsiderRel and op.outcome = ValidationFail }

mutation_targets.rationale: Without attribution constraints, the audit row's recorded actor can diverge from the operation's actual caller — exactly the FR-016/FR-002 misattribution failure mode. The injection produces an audit entry whose actorUser differs from its producing operation's caller.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_Misattribution { some op: Operation, ae: AuditEntry | ae in op.producedAudit and ae.actorUser != op.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact allows a successful create/edit/delete/share to occur without producing any audit row — the SC-007 'state change without audit' failure. The injection forces a successful CreateTask with no producedAudit set.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoAuditOnCreate { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Success and op.opKind = CreateTaskKind and no op.producedAudit }

mutation_targets.rationale: FR-012 forbids cross-team sharing; clearing this fact removes the constraint. The injection forces a Task whose sharedWith contains a user from a different team — exactly the cross-team-share leak.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamShare { some t: Task, u: t.sharedWith | u.userTeam != t.taskTeam }
